$comment: Kendama enforcement. The Stop hook turns the no-stop rule (CLAUDE.md 5x) into a technical interlock: every time the agent tries to end a turn, the stop-guard red team runs and BLOCKS the stop while it is the HUMAN'S LOCAL Saturday (America/Denver / Mountain Time — NOT UTC; a Saturday evening in MT is already Sunday in UTC, so the weekday MUST be computed in the work timezone), forcing the operator to pull the next queue item instead of idling/summarizing. Only 'it is no longer Saturday' (verified against the real clock in the work timezone) authorizes a stop. NOTE: enabling this Stop-hook config requires HUMAN APPROVAL, so it must NOT be relied upon as the enforcement mechanism — the written rule (CLAUDE.md 5z/5x) and the manual red team (node ops/checks/stop-guard.mjs) enforce WITHOUT any approval and are primary; this hook is optional belt-and-suspenders the human may enable (logged in human/NEED_FROM_HUMAN.md). The platform's hard duration limit remains the real backstop; the spend cap is the budget backstop. To disable, remove the Stop hook below (a weakening change — log it in human/APPROVALS.md per GUARDRAILS #12).
